typecheck.description: Typecheck the mobile app and report errors verbatim
typecheck.template: Run the mobile typecheck with: cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit --incremental. Report every error verbatim with file and line. Do not edit any file unless I explicitly ask you to fix them.

verify.description: Typecheck plus the full mobile test suite
verify.template: Run both gates in order and report results separately. First: cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit --incremental. Then: cd mobile && npm run test:ci. Do not edit any file. Report the exact failing test names and the first error line for each.
